answer: One concrete defense: let voting weight track irrecoverable locked capital, not headcount, with total weight conserved under any split. A small honest kernel of bonded stakers anchors the tally; the only bridge to new weight is fresh outside capital a newcomer must lock, and that locked stake is the costly signal no clone can counterfeit. A farm splitting one treasury across ten thousand fakes still wields exactly one treasury's weight, so minting identities buys nothing - a vote-stuffing quorum must outbid honest capital, never out-clone it.
